text.p: -EVEREN Securities Inc said Tuesday it cut its near-term rating on Nordson Corp to market performer from outperformer. It said it is maintaining its long-term outperformer rating on the stock.
-EVEREN analyst Quintin Nufer also lowered his first fiscal quarter earnings estimate to $0.52 from $0.55, and reduced his estimate for fiscal 1997 to $3.36 from $3.42.
-"We now believe that consensus EPS estimates are too high, and would expect Nordson shares to come under near-term pressure as estimates are revised," Nufer said in a statement.
--EVEREN said it reduced its near-term price target on Nordson to $65 from $67, and its long-term price target to $70 from $71.

--The estimate revision, Nufer said, is a result of a reduction in his revenue expectation, due partially to a larger-than-expected negative currency translation impact. Nufer said he also sees a reduction in expected operating margins.
"A pick-up in revenue growth in both Japan and in North America, accompanied by expanding operating margins, would lead us to re-visit our investment rating," he said.
